title: Entering a Web Order
breadcrumbs: Inbound and Inventory Trading Partner Management

children:
You can enter an order into the system from Trading Partner Management. 
 The file format of a web order is an XML document that is generated by 
 the system. You will have to import this order file into the system's 
 Order Entry Window for this order to become a shipment.

Log into Trading Partner Management. Choose 
 the Order Entry option from the Main Menu. The system will display the 
 Web Order Entry Window.

You will use 
 this section to indicate the item(s) and their quantity that you want 
 to add to your order.

Click the Add Button. The 
 system will display the search criteria screen.

Enter the item information, 
 and press the Search Button. The system will display the item(s) that 
 matches your criteria. Note that the system will 
 display the available quantity of the item(s) you are choosing from, if 
 you have configured your web user profile to do so.

Enter the quantity 
 of the item(s) that you want to add to your order. If you check the Delete Check box and press the Delete Button, the 
 system will remove the item quantity from your order.

Press the Add 
 Items Button. If necessary, you can enter the item's lot number 
 as well. The system will add the item quantity to the Order Detail section 
 of the Web Order Entry Window.

You will use this section to indicate the ship to address(es) for your 
 order.

Click the Add Button. The 
 system will display the search criteria screen.

Enter the pertinent ship to information, 
 and press the Search Button. The system will display the addresses 
 that match your criteria.

Choose the ship 
 to addresses that you want to associate with your order by selecting the 
 check box next to the address. Enter an Email address if appropriate. 
 Press the Add Ship To's Button. The system will add the ship to addresses 
 to the Destination section of the Web Order Entry Window. Note that if 
 you check the Delete Check box and press the Delete Button, the system 
 will remove the ship to address from your order.

You will use this section to indicate what warehouse the item(s) you 
 are ordering are housed in.

In the Warehouse 
 section, select the warehouse that contains the items you are ordering. 
 The system will then display this warehouse's address.

You will use this section to indicate the carrier/service that you want 
 to use to ship your order.

In the Carrier 
 and Service section, select the carrier/service that you want to 
 use to ship your order.

You will use this section to indicate an additional classification for 
 the order. For example, this might be defined to indicate what type of 
 monetary processing an order requires (cash or credit card).

In the Processing 
 Type section, select a process type that you want to associate 
 with this order.
You will use this section to include a comment on your order.

Enter any comments 
 that you want to include with your order. The system will save these comments 
 as header-level comments. You can define the comment type assigned to 
 web order entry comments. This is done in the Web System Values Window.

- Press 
 the Verify Order Button and the system will display a confirmation 
 screen with your order information. If all the information is correct, 
 you can press the Submit Order Button. 
 The system will then:

If your web user "order processing" 
 setting is "manual," then the system will create a file 
 with your pending order. The web order file will be stored in the directory 
 you define in the Web System Values Window.      

- To see this order as a shipment in the system, you will need to import this order on the Order Entry Window.

If your web user "order processing" setting is "automatic," the system will create the order and import it 
 into SCALE, without any user intervention.
In the verification window, you can press the Modify Order Button to return to the order entry screen to edit any of the value(s) you provided.

        Step 2: Destinations Section...

        Step 3: Warehouse Section...
        You will use this section to indicate what warehouse the item(s) you

            In the Warehouse 
 section, select the warehouse that contains the items you are ordering.

        Step 4: Carrier and Service 
 Section...
        You will use this section to indicate the carrier/service that you want 
 to use to ship your order.

 and Service section, select the carrier/service that you want to

        Finishing Your Web Order...

- To see this order as a shipment in the system, you will need to import this order on the Order Entry Window.
